Section 4 of Executive Order No. 448, dated
June 9, 1951, and section 3 of. Executive Order No. 410,
dated May 8, 1953, are hereby repealed by setting up.
new ceiling prices of galvanized iron sheets and aluminum
sheets in section 1 hereof.
Sec.. S. The ceiling prices fixed in this Order include
the 17 per cent special excise tax on foreign exchange,
the 7 per cent sales tax and 1 per cent municipal tax.

This Order shall take effect three days after
the date hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of June, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the seventh.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
